metadata.description: Primary July 2026 design, migration, ORM, and AI-context-layer sources for relational and document data models, plus foundational transaction-isolation and storage-engine references.
metadata.title: Software Database Design - Sources

relational_design.name: PostgreSQL Documentation
relational_design.description: Authoritative source for schema, indexing, constraints, and operational behavior.

relational_design.name: MySQL Documentation
relational_design.description: Official MySQL schema, indexing, and DDL reference.

relational_design.name: MongoDB Data Modeling
relational_design.description: Document-modeling patterns and tradeoffs for MongoDB.

relational_design.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
relational_design.description: Atlas Vector Search index definition, $vectorSearch stage, filtered ANN, and hybrid search via $rankFusion.

relational_design.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
relational_design.description: Lucene-based full-text search co-located with operational data; pairs with vector search for hybrid retrieval.

relational_design.name: MongoDB Building AI Applications
relational_design.description: Reference patterns for RAG, agent memory, and embedding lifecycle on Atlas.

relational_design.name: Redis Data Types
relational_design.description: Primary source for Redis storage structures and access patterns.

relational_design.name: PostgreSQL Partitioning
relational_design.description: Primary guidance for declarative partitioning design, limitations, and maintenance tradeoffs.

relational_design.name: PostgreSQL Row Security Policies
relational_design.description: Primary reference for row-level security semantics and policy behavior.

relational_design.name: PostgreSQL 18 Release Notes
relational_design.description: Current release notes for verifying version-sensitive schema and DDL behavior.

relational_design.name: SQLite Generated Columns
relational_design.description: Primary reference for generated columns in SQLite-backed application schemas.

relational_design.name: PostgreSQL Explicit Locking
relational_design.description: Authoritative lock-level reference for ALTER TABLE and DDL operations; verify lock levels here before treating a migration as safe.

relational_design.name: pgvector
relational_design.description: Primary source for pgvector version, HNSW/IVFFlat index parameters, and changelog.

relational_design.name: RFC 9562 - UUID Specification
relational_design.description: IETF standard defining UUIDv7 and successors to RFC 4122; primary source for UUID version semantics.

relational_design.name: PostgreSQL Mistakes and How to Avoid Them (Angelakos, Manning, 2025)
relational_design.description: PG16/17-era type-choice forensics (MONEY, SERIAL, CHAR(n)), UUIDv4 primary-key benchmark (table 5.4), NULLS NOT DISTINCT upserts (PG15), and major-version upgrade regressions (CTE inlining, JIT defaults).

relational_design.name: SQL Antipatterns, Volume 1 (Karwin, Pragmatic Bookshelf, 2022)
relational_design.description: Ch.3 'Naive Trees' comparison matrix for five hierarchy storage models: adjacency list, recursive query, path enumeration, nested sets, closure table.

relational_design.name: High Performance MySQL, 4th ed. (Botros & Tinley, O'Reilly, 2021)
relational_design.description: Ch.9 replication topologies (discouraged shapes, n+2 redundancy, 50-60% pool utilization, semisync degrade-to-async) and Ch.11 sharding decision path and partitioning-key selection.

orms_and_migrations.name: Prisma Schema Docs
orms_and_migrations.description: Prisma schema, relations, and migration behavior.

orms_and_migrations.name: EF Core Modeling
orms_and_migrations.description: EF Core entity modeling, relationships, and conventions.

orms_and_migrations.name: SQLAlchemy ORM
orms_and_migrations.description: SQLAlchemy ORM modeling and relationship patterns.

orms_and_migrations.name: Drizzle ORM Docs
orms_and_migrations.description: Type-safe schema definition and migration workflow for Drizzle.

transactions_and_storage_engines.name: Designing Data-Intensive Applications (Kleppmann, O'Reilly, 1st ed. 2017)
transactions_and_storage_engines.description: Ch.7 Transactions (isolation anomaly taxonomy, write skew, serializability implementations) and Ch.3 Storage and Retrieval (LSM-tree vs B-tree tradeoffs, compaction failure modes). Mechanisms are durable; vendor isolation-level defaults cited in the book are 2017-era — verify against current vendor documentation.

transactions_and_storage_engines.name: Database Internals (Petrov, O'Reilly, 2019)
transactions_and_storage_engines.description: Ch.6 Bw-Trees (latch-free delta chains + mapping table); Ch.7 LSM compaction taxonomy (leveled, size-tiered, time-window), table starvation, tombstone-handling rules, and the RUM Conjecture.
